subject: NimbusEdge private offer: commission carveout and co-term alignment - exec escalation
messages:
From: Sara Tan <sara.tan@nimbusedge.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Revised private offer request - revshare + co-term

Hi Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We ran the numbers on our side and want to push for a private offer that helps us hit go-live sooner. Specific asks:

- Rev share: 35% of marketplace revenue for the first 18 months (we understand this is above standard)
- Co-term: 36 month co-term to align with our other cloud commitments
- Payment: Net 90 for marketplace billing; early pay credit not feasible for us

I attached a marked-up term sheet (NimbusEdge_PrivOffer_v3.pdf) that calls out the deviations. If Redwood can approve these terms we will prioritize the integration and list in AWS marketplace by May 1.

We value the partnership and want to move quickly; can you advise next steps and whether this will need an exec exception?

Best,
Sara Tan
Head of Cloud Partnerships
NimbusEdge

Attachment: NimbusEdge_PrivOffer_v3.pdf (pdf)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-15T10:01:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Revised private offer request - revshare + co-term

All, forwarding NimbusEdge request. Highlights: 35% revshare for 18 months, 36 month co-term, net90 billing. They say go-live target May 1 if we can sign.

Quick context: NimbusEdge is a mid-market ISV, ~$1.2M ARR ARR via marketplace over 24 months ORR estimate per sales. Deal owner Mark Li is on cc below. Standard revshare is 20% and we generally avoid net90 because of billing cadence impact.

Can Deal Desk + Partnerships give an initial recommendation on whether this is approvable and what guardrails we should require (caps, clawbacks, shortened trial). If this needs exec signoff, pls outline the minimum ask for the exec note.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Sr. Strategic Account Executive
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: monica_patel@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-16T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Revised private offer request - revshare + co-term

Monica / Marissa,

Thanks for the ping. I reviewed the term sheet and ran a quick financial impact. Key datapoints:

- NimbusEdge estimated first 12 months marketplace revenue = $850k (conservative)
- At 35% revshare, Redwood gross take = $552.5k over 18 months (pre-cost) vs standard 20% = $680k? (note: marketplace takes and listing flows change where percentages land; see attached calc)
- Main concern is the net90 cadence which increases AR days and cash conversion risk; Finance will need to sign off.

Recommendation: escalate to exec for an exception limited by calendar and revenue caps. Proposed guardrails:
1) Approve 35% revshare only for the first 12 months post-listing, then revert to standard 20% for the remainder of the 36 month co-term
2) Total revshare cap of $375k (ceil) to protect unit economics
3) Require clawback if usage falls 30% below forecast in months 7-12
4) No changes to indemnity or data residency without Legal signoff

I attached a short financial workbook that shows sensitivity (financial-impact-NE-8942.xlsx). If Partnerships wants an even faster path, we can offer a time-boxed pilot (90 days) with a 35% revshare and review rather than blanket 18 months.

If execs approve the above package, Legal will need to sign the carveouts and Finance to accept net90 for this account. Put Marissa and Monica in the exec note.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Deal Desk Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachment: financial-impact-NE-8942.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-17T11:20:00-07:00
Subject: Exec escalation - NimbusEdge private offer exception request

Evelyn / Hannah,

Escalating for exec clearance. Summary and ask below.

Customer: NimbusEdge (ISV)
Deal: ND-8942-PR
Sales owner: Monica Patel
What they ask: 35% marketplace revshare for 18 months, 36 month co-term, net90 payment terms
Recommended package from Deal Desk: (see Karthik note)
- 35% revshare but limited to first 12 months only
- revshare cap $375k total
- clawback clause if usage drops >30% in months 7-12
- Finance must approve net90.

Why consider: They are the anchor ISV for a small vertical we want to win into; listing by May 1 would drive both revenue and references for our marketplace. If we decline, they will escalate to AWS and likely list elsewhere with a different partner.

Risks: Diluted unit economics if demand is lower than forecast; cash conversion impact from net90; legal carveouts needed on indemnity and audit scope.

Proposed exec decision options:
1) Approve the recommended package as-is with Legal and Finance conditions (preferred)
2) Approve a 90-day pilot at 35% then review metrics and decide on extension
3) Decline and offer standard marketplace terms

Please confirm which option you want to approve and any additional constraints. If you grant option 1, Legal and Finance owners will be looped for final signoff and we will prepare a DocuSign bundle for the customer. Time is sensitive; Mark Li told me the customer expects an answer by end of week.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com, james.brook@twinbridgelaw.com
Date: 2028-03-18T16:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec escalation - NimbusEdge private offer exception request

Marissa / team,

Thanks for the clear summary. After a quick review and a consult with Finance, I am willing to approve a constrained exception with the following binding conditions:

1) Approve 35% revshare only for the first 12 months post-listing. After month 12 revert to standard 20% for the remainder of the 36 month co-term.
2) Total revshare paid to NimbusEdge under this contract cannot exceed $300k. This lowers the Deal Desk recommendation but preserves a tighter margin band.
3) Net90 is provisionally accepted but Finance requires a letter of credit or early-pay reserve of 15% to mitigate collection risk. Finance owner will circulate exact language.
4) Legal must add a bespoke clawback tied to verified usage metrics and an audit clause limited to marketplace transactions only. James Brook from TwinBridge law is copied to begin redline work.
5) This exception is conditional on a 90-day operational review. If usage is below forecast in that window, revshare terms will be renegotiated retroactively.

Please prepare an exec approval memo that includes the following: expected first 12 month revenue, proposed cap mechanics, clear definitions for usage metric triggers, and a drafted DocuSign envelope. Once Legal provides final language and Finance signs off on the letter of credit, I will sign the exception.

Monica, please confirm you can get NimbusEdge to accept the cap and the 90-day review requirement. Marissa / Karthik, coordinate to update the term sheet and loop James for legal redlines.

Approved in principle with the conditions above.

Evelyn Hart
VP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: exec-approval-note-NE8942.txt (text)
